final_text:
A live “agent activity board” shows all ten agents as compact cards, grouped by task, with a plain-language current action, last progress update, and a clear state: working, waiting, or possibly stuck.

The owner can scan the board, spot stale or blocked agents by age of last progress, and open a card to see its latest status and relevant chat excerpt; a waiting agent’s card can show what input it needs.

Unlike a log list, the board makes state and progress comparable across agents at once, so the owner can find exceptions without opening ten separate histories.

Main risk: status labels may be misleading if agents report progress inconsistently or go quiet during legitimate long-running work.
